C1689.title: Apache Log4j Vulnerability Incident
C1689.summary: In late 2021, the widely used Java logging library Apache Log4j disclosed a critical vulnerability affecting nearly all Java-based applications. Due to the lack of an SBOM, organizations could not quickly identify whether their own products or supplier deliverables contained the affected Log4j version, making it difficult to assess the scope of impact and prioritize remediation.
